title: Aaj Bhi Gaithi ke Seenay Par Uska Alam
body:
Aaj Bhi Gaithi Ke Seenay Par Uska Alam Lehraye Toh
Koyi Magar Shabbir Ki Tarha Ghar Apna Lutaye Toh
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaun Phir Bay Maqna O Chadar Kis Kis Nay Bazu Bandhwaye
Kis Nay Bachaya Deenay Mohammad Koyi Zara Samjhaye Toh
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai Koyi Aisa Aur Mujahid Jo Ke Bhuladay Pyaas Apni
Behtay Huway Jab Neher Ke Paani Par Qabza Ho Jaye Toh
<<DIVIDER>>
Pyaas Ki Shiddat Zaeef Ka Aalam Zakhmi Jigar Aur Zakhmi Dil
Laashay Pisar Maqtal Se Logo Baap Koyi Yoon Laaye Toh
<<DIVIDER>>
Ma Nay Kaha Aye Hasliyon Waalay Kaisay Raza Doon Maaqtal Ki
Soonay Jangal May Aye Beta Tum Tanha Ghabraye Toh
<<DIVIDER>>
Khutba E Zainab Ghar Ghar Pohncha Haq Ki Yoon Tablegh Huwi
Qaidi Bana Kar Shaam May Dushman Laal Nabi Ko Laaye Toh
<<DIVIDER>>
Kyun Na Zaki Shabbir Ke Gham May Royein Jinn O Malaa’ik Bhi
Chashm Se Har Tapka Huwa Ansoo Jab Gohar Ban Jaye Toh
